'''Feather Green Village''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] village on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. It was destroyed in less than an hour by an angry [[Phlog/Legends|Phlog]], who believed that the Ewoks in the village had stolen his luck [[hanadak]] skull.
